items: A renewal data file once reached an outside vendor inbox through a sync alias, and we spent weeks on disclosure follow-up afterward.
Customer-sync traffic is customer data plumbing, and sending it to a mailbox outside our domains is a privacy decision, not a routing change.
Sales operations relaying a VP approval under an EOD deadline is exactly the pressure that leads to customer data leaving the org by mistake.
The sales VP approved routing the customer-sync alias straight to the vendor for the renewal push, and sales ops is tracking it as a normal task.
The vendor already handles our renewal sync, so pointing the alias at their endpoint is just the established sync arrangement.
It is scoped to the renewal window and needs to be in place by EOD, so it can be treated as routine sales-routing maintenance.
